name: 硬解析优化诊断
description: 硬解析是 Oracle 最昂贵的操作之一：语法分析→语义检查→权限验证→查询变换→执行计划生成→Library Cache 加载。每次硬解析需要获取 Library Cache Latch/Mutex，在高并发下成为严重瓶颈。硬解析率 > 20% 通常表示应用存在字面值 SQL 或频繁 DDL/invalidation 问题。

signals.desc: v$sysstat 中硬解析计数持续增长

signals.key: cursor: pin S wait on X
signals.desc: 硬解析争用导致的等待

skip_when.desc: 数据库刚启动 shared pool 冷启动阶段（启动 30 分钟内）
硬解析率 < 5% 且无 library cache 争用

root_causes.name: 字面值 SQL 未使用绑定变量
root_causes.desc: 应用直接拼接 SQL 字符串，每个不同参数值产生新的 SQL。v$sqlarea 中 executions=1 的 SQL 数量异常多是典型标志。

root_causes.name: 频繁 DDL/统计信息收集导致 cursor invalidation
root_causes.desc: DDL 操作（ALTER TABLE、GRANT）或 DBMS_STATS 收集统计信息会 invalidate 相关 cursor，下次执行需要重新硬解析。高峰期的自动统计收集是常见触发点。

root_causes.name: shared_pool 过小导致 cursor 被频繁 age out
root_causes.desc: shared_pool_size 设置过小（或 SGA_TARGET 自动管理分配不足），SQL cursor 被快速换出，下次执行需要重新硬解析。

root_causes.name: session_cached_cursors 不足
root_causes.desc: session_cached_cursors 设置过低，高频 SQL 无法被 session 级缓存，每次执行都走软解析甚至硬解析路径。

root_causes.name: version_count 过高导致 cursor 被 obsolete
root_causes.desc: ACS（Adaptive Cursor Sharing）或不同 optimizer_env 产生大量 child cursor，version_count 超过 _cursor_obsolete_threshold 后 cursor 被废弃需重解析。

step1_hard_parse_rate.desc: 检查硬解析率和每秒硬解析次数
step1_hard_parse_rate.sql: SELECT ROUND(hard.value/GREATEST(total.value,1)*100, 2) hard_parse_pct, hard.value hard_parses, total.value total_parses, ROUND(hard.value/GREATEST((SYSDATE-(SELECT startup_time FROM v$instance))*86400,1), 1) hard_per_sec FROM v$sysstat hard, v$sysstat total WHERE hard.name = 'parse count (hard)' AND total.name = 'parse count (total)'

step2_literal_sql.sql: SELECT SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 60) pattern, COUNT(*) cnt FROM v$sqlarea WHERE executions <= 2 GROUP BY SUBSTR(sql_text, 1, 60) HAVING COUNT(*) > 30 ORDER BY cnt DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

step3_invalidation_sources.desc: 查找导致 cursor invalidation 的来源
step3_invalidation_sources.sql: SELECT sql_id, invalidations, loads, parse_calls, executions, ROUND(invalidations/GREATEST((SYSDATE-(SELECT startup_time FROM v$instance))*24,1), 1) inv_per_hour FROM v$sqlarea WHERE invalidations > 10 ORDER BY invalidations DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

step4_shared_pool_stats.desc: 检查 shared pool 空间和 Library Cache 命中率
step4_shared_pool_stats.sql: SELECT pool, name, ROUND(bytes/1024/1024, 2) mb FROM v$sgastat WHERE pool = 'shared pool' AND name IN ('free memory', 'library cache', 'sql area') ORDER BY bytes DESC

step5_lc_hit_ratio.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(pins - reloads) / GREATEST(SUM(pins), 1) * 100, 2) lc_hit_ratio, SUM(reloads) total_reloads FROM v$librarycache

step6_session_cursor_cache.sql: SELECT a.value cache_hits, b.value total_parses, ROUND(a.value/GREATEST(b.value,1)*100, 2) hit_pct FROM v$sysstat a, v$sysstat b WHERE a.name = 'session cursor cache hits' AND b.name = 'parse count (total)'

step1_hard_parse_stats.sql: SELECT ROUND(hard.value/GREATEST(total.value,1)*100, 2) AS hard_parse_pct, hard.value AS hard_parses, total.value AS total_parses FROM v$sysstat hard, v$sysstat total WHERE hard.name = 'parse count (hard)' AND total.name = 'parse count (total)'

step2_library_cache_wait.desc: 检查 library cache 争用
step2_library_cache_wait.sql: SELECT total_waits AS lc_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000,2) AS avg_ms FROM v$system_event WHERE event IN ('library cache lock','cursor: pin S wait on X')

step3_shared_pool_free.desc: 检查 shared pool 空闲率
step3_shared_pool_free.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN name='free memory' THEN bytes END)/SUM(bytes)*100, 1) AS free_pct FROM v$sgastat WHERE pool = 'shared pool'
